name: ai-native-collaboration
description: A self-hosted workspace for humans and local AI agents to collaborate on conversations, work items, and artifacts.

scripts.build: npm run package:local-computer && npm run build:api && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.dev: npm run package:local-computer && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.test:integration:backend: vitest run tests/http-api.test.ts tests/conversation-visibility.test.ts tests/agent-session-window.test.ts tests/artifact-v2.test.ts tests/local-computer-worker.test.ts
scripts.test:regression: npm run openapi:lint && npm run db:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.check: npm run openapi:lint && npm run db:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.openapi:check: npm run openapi && git diff --exit-code -- docs/contracts/openapi.json web/src/api/generated.ts
scripts.verify:public: npm run openapi:lint && npm run openapi:check && npm run db:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run docs:check && npm run license:check && npm run assets:check && npm run package:check && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace web
